title: City of Melbourne Census of Land Use and Employment (CLUE): business establishments with address and industry classification, every census year since 2002
provider: City of Melbourne, Open Data Platform (Opendatasoft Explore API v2.1): dataset business-establishments-with-address-and-industry-classification
credit: CLUE: City of Melbourne, CC BY 4.0
licence: CC BY 4.0 (stated in the dataset's metadata)
citation: City of Melbourne, Census of Land Use and Employment (CLUE), Business establishments with address and industry classification, https://data.melbourne.vic.gov.au/explore/dataset/business-establishments-with-address-and-industry-classification/ ; definitions: https://www.melbourne.vic.gov.au/clue
format: CSV separated by semicolons, with a byte-order mark: census_year, block_id (the CLUE block), property_id, base_property_id, clue_small_area, trading_name, business_address, industry_anzsic4_code and industry_anzsic4_description (the Australian and New Zealand Standard Industrial Classification 2006, class of four digits), longitude, latitude (WGS 84; the property's point, shared by every establishment in it). One row an establishment and a census year.
coverage: The municipality of the City of Melbourne, census years 2002 to 2024 (413,550 rows when registered, about 13,500 to 19,900 a year), every commercial property surveyed at least once every two years by field interview

all.description: Every establishment of every census year (about 65 MB; fetch again with --refresh after the City adds a year)
